title: Sales and purchase invoice ledgers
definition: The complete invoice ledger for a period, showing every invoice raised or received, the counterparty, the amount and the date. It is requested where a sample of transactions has to be tested against the whole population, and it establishes whether the sampled pattern is the norm or the exception.
evidence_to_cite: the ledger, with the period it covers and the system it was taken from
the reconciliation of the ledger total to the reported turnover
the sampling method, where a sample was drawn

sources.citation: Transaction records supporting a pattern assessment, summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
